decision.reason: The user asked to cut rc.35 without a benchmark round so the first release with the corrected MCP Registry name (#151) publishes the npm packages by trusted publishing and lists Tracetoon in the MCP Registry, within npm's 48-hour window for the newly created trusted-publisher configurations. The retained prbench inputs needed for calibration and admission are not available on the release machine, so the CI-tested candidate is released without a benchmark round. No evaluation result or performance gain is claimed.
